beschreibung:
The entry Wellcafe refers to the Imst region in the Tyrolean Gurgltal. No clear official source confirming this establishment with an address, contact details or opening hours could be found.

The Imst-Gurgltal region lies in the Tyrolean Oberland and is characterised by a mountain landscape with the Rosengartenschlucht gorge, the Venet and the Gurgltal. In Tarrenz, the Knappenwelt Gurgltal museum recalls the medieval mining that once shaped the area. The Tyrolean cuisine of the surroundings is known for coffee specialities, homemade cakes and traditional dishes such as Käsespätzle or Tiroler Gröstl.
